title: Unreal Desserts Banana Toffee 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Banana Toffee from Unreal Desserts combines the creamy taste of ripe bananas with the rich sweetness of toffee for a truly indulgent vaping experience. Each puff delivers the comforting flavour of banana blended with the decadent notes of toffee, making it perfect for dessert lovers. Unreal Dessert Shortfills offer a convenient way to enjoy your favourite flavours with the option to personalise nicotine levels. Each 100ml bottle of nicotine-free e-liquid has an additional 20ml of space for two nicotine shots. To achieve a 3mg nicotine strength, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots, shake well, and your e-liquid is ready to vape. Shortfill e-liquids are an economical and long-lasting option for vapers, particularly those using high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils. The higher VG content in shortfills ensures maximum flavour and vapour production, making them ideal for sub-ohm vaping. Unreal Desserts are a range of 100ml shortfills made in the UK by Unreal e-liquids, a brand celebrated for their creative and delectable flavours. With Unreal Desserts, you can enjoy classic dessert flavours in a convenient and cost-effective format, perfect for any vaper.
